operation: Frozen full-V posterior query: mass interval, a valid sample and all original-token marginals with deterministic TV<=epsilon versus full recursive JSON. Whole generation is a later separate experiment.
primary: paired median total wall AND CPU <=0.8 of EVERY mandatory comparator, favorable sign in EVERY conclusive repetition, or localized capacity gain under equal budgets. Must certify epsilon and be complete in all repetitions.
within_family: Report handoff versus closed on every case; the two variants belong to the same candidate family. A separate refinement speed claim requires handoff>=20% faster than closed, never inferred from bound dominance.
selection: Choose ONE candidate only on development count of strong wins against all mandatory comparators; tie handoff. No strong wins rejects practical family gate. Other variant stays ablation.
cold: Cold timings include service table/normalizer preparation; primary includes conversion, all attempted depths/fallbacks, all original marginals and SAME archived model forward+softmax. Report both, never hide preparation.
sampling: Rejection is an exact first-sample comparator, not a deterministic mass/marginal query. No sampling-only victory without beating it AND all first-sample-capable controls.
correctness: Check computed L<=Z<=L+U and actual conditional TV=(Z-L)/Z<=reported delta whenever any exact control completes. Exact control matrices must agree independently. Missing/failed control is not imaginary ground truth.
independent: Only after development gate, evaluate ALL five previously unmodeled positive object/array JSONTestSuite documents, pinned1ef36fa01286573e846ac449e8683f8833c5b26a, original bytes, 16..96 GPT2 tokens. Same mask_counts/all methods/nine rotations; no filtering by candidate certificate/latency.
trajectory: After operation confirmation, a separately frozen real dLLM loop uses the same common commit policy with epsilon budget along EVERY history. Query timings are not end-to-end generation nor semantic accuracy.
claims: No training/native EPIC or FactorDLM victory, no exclusive abstraction principle, no human review/publication or mathematical priority invented.

independent_corpus.eligibility: ALL y_ object/array documents with strict UTF8/Python json acceptance and16..96 GPT2 tokens, original bytes unchanged; no result-based selection
independent_corpus.selection: All eligible, hash order by seed/original text; previously unmodeled documents. All losses remain.

external.scope: tests/draft2020-12/*.json, all object/array data regardless of schema validity, canonical compact sorted-key ASCII JSON; distinct documents
